reviews.title: Fantastic monitor
reviews.comment: Fantastic monitor and excellent price. Best monitor purchase I've ever made. Excellent display highest resolution. Be sure to get a DP (Display Port) cable to use the higher resolutions and refresh rates.
reviews.author: C. Granger

reviews.title: Great quality, easy to set up, and well-worth the cost.
reviews.comment:
I bought two of these, one for me and the other for my partner. Setup was a snap. Just fasten the base, plug in, and play. The only issue we had was that the direction book made it seem that the joystick-like control on the back was the power button, but the power button is a separate one underneath the aforementioned control.
The quality of the visuals on the monitor are stunning and quite an upgrade from much smaller, flat screens capable of 1920x1080 at maximum. The curve on this is immersive-feeling as described, and my games really POP when I run them.
reviews.author: Lilith Isley

reviews.title: decent monitor for the price!
reviews.comment: hooked it up and works perfect! no complaints so far, video looks decent, easy assembly. haven't had it for very long to tell if there are going to be problems. just as a for now monitor it works as described. built in speakers work better than expected! can't wait to game on it. dp cable and of course power cable came included.
reviews.author: oliver pease

reviews.title: Vibrant image at a good price.
reviews.comment: Slick and sharp, vibrant colors, nice deep blacks. Decent value for the price.
